texts: How many Keepers are active in the present generation?

fields.sentence: How many Keepers are active in the present generation?
parse: (: $prf (And (Member sk_generation_1 generation) (GroupOf sk_generation_1 keeper) (Member sk_generation_1 present) (GroupOf $g keeper) (SubsetOf $g sk_generation_1) (Cardinality $g $n) (Inheritance $g active)) $tv)

q1_issues.issue: The query hard-codes the invented witness symbol sk_generation_1 instead of binding the definite 'the present generation' as a variable constrained by its kind, so it can only match a KB that happens to have minted that exact symbol.
(GroupOf sk_generation_1 keeper) builds into the pattern that the generation is a group whose members are keepers, which the question does not state - it says Keepers are active in that generation.
The partitive superset/SubsetOf machinery is used although the question carries no 'of the / of them' partitive cue, so the pattern matches only a partitive storage the sentence never licenses.

(Inheritance $g active) predicates the property of a group witness with Inheritance, which is licensed only for a partitive subset group; a copular predicate over a plural is stored as a per-member distribution rule, not as an atom on the group.

q2_gaps: a counting question whose predicate is copular ('how many Ns are ADJ?') - the Counting-questions shape anchors the counted group to an event, and a copular predicate over a plural is stored as a per-member distribution rule that a flat query conjunct cannot bind
review.notes: Only (GroupOf $g keeper) (Cardinality $g $n) is well-formed; everything anchoring the count to the question's restriction is invented structure. 'In the present generation' is never given the reified-state plus preposition-named In oblique route the instruction set would allow.

issues.reason: Existential/definite states that in a query a definite common noun is bound by its kind (the 'Who built the bridge?' pattern), so the translator-minted constant sk_generation_1 can only match a KB that happens to hold that exact symbol.

Core patterns' point-at-the-words test fails: nothing in 'How many Keepers are active in the present generation?' says the generation's members are keepers, so (GroupOf sk_generation_1 keeper) builds an unstated restriction into the pattern.

Partitives fire only on an 'of the / of these / of them' cue with a cardinal or non-universal-proportional amount; with no cue the licensed shape is Counting questions' plain (GroupOf $g keeper) (Cardinality $g $n), so the superset + SubsetOf conjuncts demand a storage the question never licenses.

Categorical statements attaches a property of a minted group witness by Member, Inheritance on a group being the deliberate exception for a partitive subset alone, and a copular predicate over a plural is stored kind-level or per-member — so (Inheritance $g active) binds no licensed storage.

gaps_confirmed: 'how many Ns are ADJ?' has no licensed query form: Counting questions anchors the counted group to an event, while a copular predicate over a plural is stored either as a kind-level Inheritance or as a per-member distribution rule, neither of which a flat conjunct on the counted group can bind
new_gaps: a domain/period restriction inside a counting question ('... in the present generation'): the restriction can only ride a reified per-member state (preposition-named In oblique), and nothing ties that state back to the counted group, so count and restriction cannot be co-bound in one query
adjudication.defect_summary: Issue 0: the definite must be bound by its kind — (Member $gen generation) (Member $gen present) — never by a hard-coded sk_ constant. Issue 1: (GroupOf sk_generation_1 keeper) has no licensing words and the compliant form simply omits it. Issue 2: the partitive superset/SubsetOf/subset-group machinery is dropped in favour of Counting questions' (GroupOf $g keeper) (Cardinality $g $n). Issue 3: no licensed conjunct binds the copular 'are active' to a counted group at all — the instruction set licenses NO compliant form for the predicate half of this question, filed as the confirmed gap.
adjudication.notes: Only (GroupOf $g keeper) (Cardinality $g $n) survives; the count-bearing half of the question is licensed while the 'are active in the present generation' half is not, so a re-parse needs new coverage, not just a rewrite.
